comment: The PMC squad commander's utility weights (docs/systems/pmc-squad-ai.md; PmcCommanderRules::FromJson). One file = one personality; CodexTactics.PmcArena weightsA= / weightsB= load another file (absolute, or a name in Content/Data/AI). Missing keys keep the code defaults. Order weights multiply the 0..1 considerations of each order; the thresholds below tune the considerations. The overnight trainer edits copies of this file, never the code.
name: default
_stalemate_comment: Order commitment and the push (fix/pmc-arena-stalemate, the designer 2026-11-08: the night trainer's fights froze in corners): order_min_hold_s = a running order is kept this long unless it turns invalid (scores 0), then move_switch_margin / switch_margin apply; failed_order_cooldown_s = an order that ended without reaching its goal (no path, dropped walk, detour failed) is not picked again for this long; repath_after_s = a walk without 1 m of progress for this long takes a detour (an alternative route) once, then fails; push_after_s = in the arena's objective rounds, this long without a shot between the sides both push - the attackers onto the point (Objective x push, their cover / hold orders / push), the defenders back onto it; rpg_gunner_share = the squad's chance of an RPG gunner when the arena spawns it (overrides pmc_operators.json rpg_gunner.share; -1 = the operators file). push_after_s and repath_after_s are the designer's rules (frozen in the bounds), the rest are trainer genes.
_detour_comment: Detours and levels (fix/pmc-onpoint-3d-detour, Gemini review 009 of the pmc-v3 night, approved by the game designer 2026-11-11): a walk without 1 m of progress for repath_after_s takes the next re-route step - a side waypoint (detour_side_cm off his line to the goal, either side; 1.5 x further out, back-diagonal), then the side opposite the one taken, then a short step back (detour_step_back_cm along the way he came) after which the walk re-routes to its goal; detour_max = how many of those steps (1 = the old one-side rule), then the order fails. level_tolerance_cm = one height level for the walks' arrival tests (feet vs the navmesh goal; a walk that ends a floor below its goal did not arrive). The designer's rules: frozen in the bounds.
_rpg_comment: rpg_strike (the game designer 2026-11-09: an RPG suppress / breach option when the squad has an RPG gunner): the RpgStrike order = rpg_strike x min(1, the shared launcher rule's best target score among the targets the team sees - a cluster, a man in cover, a group to suppress; Content/Data/Combat/launcher_tactics.json, ordered_threshold) x 0.85 unless a mate flanks / advances, x0.2 while a mate already fires one. The gunner draws the launcher, fires one rocket, goes back to his rifle. A trainer gene (+-50 %).
_engagement_comment: Engagement bands (user request 2026-11-04: 'a man with an assault rifle keeps as far from his target as his weapon allows, fires from corners, prone, never at point-blank range; a pistol comes closer but not point-blank; the shotgun is the close-range weapon'; the BAND NUMBERS ARE PENDING the user's confirmation). Per weapon id (weapons_tuning.json) the distance to the threat he wants to fight from; the band is capped at band_reach_frac x the weapon's reach (m16 reaches 25 m, the sniper rifle 30 m: their bands become ~20-24 / ~23-29 m) and keeps a fifth of its width below that; a weapon with no row gets default_band_*_frac x its reach. standoff = the 'too close' FallBack to the band's middle (cover at band distance first) when the threat is nearer than standoff_trigger_frac x the band's min (close_quarters weapons never back off; they close in: Advance x close_in); band_position = how much Hold / Suppress / Crouch / a TakeCover slot lose outside the band (band_close_floor = the factor at point-blank range); corner_bonus = a cover slot at a free corner (peek / fire round it); prone_min_band_cm = a weapon whose band starts this far goes prone instead of crouching in the open at band distance. use_engagement_bands false = the old behaviour (A/B).
_objective_comment: The arena's round objective (task #53): objective = the Objective order (an attacker onto the point; a defender's is 0 inside the defended area and a flat walk back outside it, see _defence_comment); objective_urgency = the attacker's time pressure (x 1 - u + u x the round's time fraction: the defenders win at the time limit); objective_approach = attackers value cover on the way to / round the point and holding on it; overwatch = defenders value cover / holding within reach of the point (their band's max). Trainer genes +-50 % (pmc_commander.bounds.json); off the arena (no objective) they change nothing.
_defence_comment: PMC defender roles (docs/design/PMC_DEFENCE.md D1, G008). Frozen numbers, not trainer genes: pmc_commander.bounds.json is not extended. guard_dist_m = a living defender within this of the roof access, on its level, counts for guard_near_access_share. guard_inset_m = the access guard stands this far from the stair head / hatch / ladder top toward the roof (he does not stand in the hole; a ladder guard looks back out through the top). min_spacing_m / spacing_penalty = a cover slot of the same wall actor scores 0, and a slot within min_spacing_m of a claimed slot scores x spacing_penalty once. area_factor = on the ground the defended area is the point radius times this; inside it (and on a roof, inside the spot span) the defender's Objective order is 0, so he is not pulled into the capture ring. shift_after_s = a sector shooter may relocate to the next spot of his own wedge only after this long on his post, and only when under fire or with no target seen for shift_no_target_s; shift_cooldown_s = the least time between two shifts of one shooter (no ping-pong between two spots). defence_post_walks = walks to a defence post that end short (or are refused) before he drops it for the nearest reachable roof spot (a second drop: where he stands), like the tactical posts' three short walks. Off his post a defender walks there before contact; in contact the walk is one order among the fight orders. sector_arc_deg = the arc facing the attacker spawn, split across the sector shooters. heal_reach_m (G010) = a defender standing on his post (a defence post, or a ranged tactical post) scores Heal 0 when the wounded mate is farther than this, so he does not walk off the stair or the post to reach him; within it he heals in place. The heal walk uses the same reach. Frozen, not a trainer gene.
_attention_comment: Target attention (user 2026-11-07: strike when the operatives look away, through their blind zones): attention = Flank / Advance / an attacker's Objective walk x (1 + attention x (off - 0.5)), off = how far he stands outside the look sectors (+-45 deg) of the enemies his team sees now (their facing as seen); a flank takes the other side's point when that one is clearly less watched. An objective defender in ambush holds his fire while off < ambush_patience, unless the target is deep in the kill zone (kill_zone_frac x his reach, or on the point), a shot was already exchanged, he is seen, or ambush_max_hold_s passed since the first contact. Trainer genes +-50 %.
_tactical_comment: The tactical map (docs/design/TACTICAL_MAP.md P2, the designer 2026-11-17: the dangerous places affect gameplay; AI/PmcTacticalRules.h). Only on a map with a tactical file (Content/Data/LevelGen/tactical/<Map>.tactical.json); without one every term is 1 and nothing changes. terrain_danger = the danger of his position (DangerAt(feet, Pmc): inside a chokepoint): Hold / Crouch / Suppress / Ambush off a post x (1 - terrain_danger x danger), TakeCover / Relocate x (1 + terrain_danger x danger), cover slots and post candidates x (1 - terrain_danger x danger); choke_leave_danger = in contact at this danger he relocates before he is spotted; ambush_exit / overwatch_roof / window_position = the Ambush order and the placement value an ambush post at a chokepoint exit / the marksman's overwatch roof / a window covering the route x (1 + weight x its score); route_cover = a cover slot whose wall faces the squad's route x (1 + route_cover x facing; half when no analysis cover spot is within 2.5 m); chokepoint_avoid = a FallBack goal x (1 - chokepoint_avoid x its danger) over 5 directions (straight away first); window_share = the seeded share of riflemen the placement sends to windows (after the squad's first ambusher, who always takes the best chokepoint-exit spot). Trainer genes. tactical_reach_m (posts within this of the route), marksman_band_min_m (a band starting this far = a marksman; else the squad's longest reach), ladder_roof_men (men on the picked ladder-only roofs; the picker keeps the file's 0.65): frozen. G008b (PMC_DEFENCE P1b): a defender on an overwatch roof post keeps Ambush until a known enemy is within the smaller of that roof's range_m and his weapon reach, and for ambush_max_hold_s after that in-range contact. A hit, suppression, a wound below fall_back_below, or being too close for his band ends the hold sooner. Outnumbered does not. ShouldHoldFire still counts ambush_max_hold_s from the team's first contact. T-06: a window or ambush post uses the weapon band's max as that range (the weapon reach when the band is missing). Ladder and drop posts have no range.

firing_positions._comment: Firing positions (smart enemies T-05, docs/design/gdd/smart-enemies.md section 5 + F2; AI/FiringPositionRules.h, UFiringPositionSubsystem). FROZEN numbers, not trainer genes. A position is a stand point + stance + facing that a line trace from its muzzle reaches the covered area from: the same ECC_Visibility line a real shot uses. crossfire_min_deg = two hammers on one kill zone differ by at least this in bearing (best 60-120); line_clear_cm = a mate this close to the segment shooter -> zone is in his line of fire (not a crossfire). area_samples = a 3x3 grid over the area (9) or its centre (1), each sample must be standable (navmesh) and is aimed at sample_height_cm above the floor - 80 is where AOperativeCharacter::EvaluateShotLine aims (feet + 80), so a clear line here is a clear real shot. min_covered_share = a position that reaches less of the area's samples (inside the weapon band) is dropped. rim_search_max_cm = how far from the tactical file's roof spot toward the area the walk surface is followed to find the rim (T-05 diagnosis: the overwatch spots are not at the rim - the walk surface runs on 15+ m past them and the line to the street hits the roof slab first); rim_step_cm / rim_step_max_cm = the stand point is tried at the rim and 10 cm steps back from it up to 80 cm (on the walkable surface) per stance; none clears = dropped and logged as a generator fault. muzzle_height_cm = the muzzle above the feet per stance, a mirror of AOperativeCharacter::GetMuzzleLocation (FiringPositionSmoke compares). w_danger = F2 (1 - w_danger x danger). roof_protect + high_ground per storey = the protect term of a roof edge (the 100 cm parapet + height); window_protect = the wall beside a window frame. escape_* = F2's escape term: a second way out / one way / a ladder-only roof (0.65 occupancy factor is separate). min_spacing_m / spacing_penalty = the G008 numbers (the same cover object scores 0, within min_spacing_m x spacing_penalty). scan_* / max_* = the cover-slot scan of an area (ONE scan per area per round, shared by every man's weapon band, cached): a world-anchored grid every scan_step_cm out to the widest ring asked for (nearest first, cut at max_scan_points; beyond scan_dense_cm only every scan_far_stride-th grid line), scan_rays rays of scan_reach_cm from each point, at most max_cover_slots slots (on the area's level, inside the ring) per area. T-05 phase b diagnosis: the old polar grid thinned by one stride made a WIDER ring sparser (tier 2 found fewer slots than tier 1). band_min_factor / band_max_factor / band_max_factor_tier2 = a defender's weapon band as a share of his weapon's max range (tier 2 = the wider fallback when tier 1 seats nobody; band_min_factor 0.18 = 0.2 of the 0.9 band). area_radius_floor_cm = the defended area is at least this wide. roof_reach_factor = a roof defence's kill zone lies this share of the lead's reach out toward the attackers. kill_zone_reach_factor = a GROUND defence's kill zone is the point on the attackers' nav path (spawn -> objective) this share of the shooters' MEDIAN weapon reach before the objective (at most the whole path): contact happens out on the approach, so the crossfire pair is chosen around where the first shots fall, not around the objective (T-05 phase b diagnosis: pairs of 46-143 deg at the objective were 17-34 deg seen from the attackers at the first shot; sweep on 10 seeds: 0.25 best - 0.4 / 0.6 send the defenders 25-36 m out and the attackers catch them walking). default_reach_cm = the reach of a man without a weapon. forward_margin_cm = a ground position is forward of the kill zone only when it is nearer the attackers ALONG the approach axis by more than this (flank positions beside the zone qualify; crossfire needs them; 800 = 8 m: a defender a little ahead of the objective is still in the area). min_cover_quality = a cover slot is a candidate only when its wall stands between it and the area within this CoverQualityAgainst (FindCoverNear uses 0.35; 0 = also walls beside him). defence_use = objective defenders take firing positions before contact (phase b; PmcSquadSubsystem) - false = the G008 sector spots as before.
